changelog: **The hiring desk, `/admin/hiring` (#1874):** four queues of things waiting on the programme owner — interview requests awaiting a decision (oldest first, days waiting), stalled applications (open, latest `ApplicationEvent` older than the new `hiringStallDays` setting, default 14, clamped 1…365; the clock is derived from the events, terminal stages never appear), offers expiring within 7 days (soonest first) and open roles with a seat left and no open application (`filled < openings` as a column comparison). New `GET /api/admin/hiring/queues` (ADMIN only, tenant-scoped, `placements` capability) runs one bounded query per queue (`take: 20`) plus a `count()` on the same `where`, and the header numbers — open roles, hires this month (applications reaching `HIRED` since the 1st, UTC), offers outstanding, offer acceptance over 90 days (accepted ÷ accepted + declined + expired; withdrawn counts on neither side; `null` when nothing was decided) — as counts and one `groupBy`: a constant number of queries whatever the tenant's size, nothing stored. Every row links to the screen where the action is taken; an empty queue says so; a failed load shows an error with a retry. `AdminNav` gets the link with a badge summing the two actionable queues, read from `?summary=1` (two counts). Rules in `src/lib/hiringQueues.ts`.

en: New hiring desk for programme admins: interview requests awaiting a decision, stalled applications, offers about to expire and open roles with no applicants — on one screen, each with a link to where you act.
tr: Program yöneticileri için yeni işe alım masası: karar bekleyen mülakat talepleri, takılan başvurular, süresi dolmak üzere olan teklifler ve adayı olmayan açık pozisyonlar — tek ekranda, her biri işlem yapılacak yere bağlantılı.
de: Neuer Recruiting-Schreibtisch für Programm-Admins: Gesprächsanfragen ohne Entscheidung, festgefahrene Bewerbungen, bald ablaufende Angebote und offene Stellen ohne Bewerbungen – auf einem Bildschirm, jeweils mit einem Link dorthin, wo du handelst.
